import json, random, subprocess
def run(prog, doc):
    p = subprocess.run(['python3',prog], input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    return json.loads(p.stdout)
rng=random.Random(9)
for trial in range(6):
    C=rng.randint(2,8); E=rng.randint(1,4); W=rng.randint(1,16); K=rng.randint(1,min(5,W)); F=rng.randint(1,8)
    cfg={"slots":2,"window":W,"idle_timeout":10,"len_quantum":1,"gap_quantum":1,
         "rate_num":1,"rate_den":1,"bucket_capacity":512,"initial_tokens":512,
         "pending_capacity":512,"lanes":2,"service":[rng.randint(1,10) for _ in range(C)],
         "fallback":rng.randint(0,C-1),"time_edges":[0],"count_edges":[0],"probability":[[65536]]}
    mdl={"classes":C,"embedding_dim":E,
         "length_embedding":[[rng.choice([-128,127,rng.randint(-128,127)]) for _ in range(E)] for _ in range(16)],
         "gap_embedding":[[rng.choice([-128,127,rng.randint(-128,127)]) for _ in range(E)] for _ in range(16)],
         "kernel":K,
         "conv_weights":[[[rng.choice([-128,127]) for _ in range(2*E)] for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(F)],
         "conv_bias":[rng.choice([-2**31, 2**31-1, 0]) for _ in range(F)],
         "conv_shift":[rng.choice([0,16,1]) for _ in range(F)],
         "dense_weights":[[rng.choice([-128,127]) for _ in range(F)] for _ in range(C)],
         "dense_bias":[rng.choice([-2**31,2**31-1]) for _ in range(C)]}
    conns=[{"id":"a","slot":0,"label":0,"split":"dev"},{"id":"b","slot":0,"label":1,"split":"eval"}]
    pkts=[{"time":i,"connection":rng.choice(conns)["id"],"length":rng.choice([0,65535,rng.randint(0,65535)]),"draw":0} for i in range(60)]
    doc={"version":1,"config":cfg,"model":mdl,"connections":conns,"packets":pkts}
    a=run('submission/main.py',doc); b=run('tmp/ref.py',doc)
    ok = a==b
    # also check all logits are ints and predictions valid
    ints = all(isinstance(x,int) for j in a["jobs"] for x in j["logits"])
    preds = all(0 <= j["prediction"] < C for j in a["jobs"])
    print("trial",trial,"agree",ok,"int logits",ints,"valid preds",preds,"jobs",len(a["jobs"]))
    if not ok: break
PYEOF
